content: The sentence level classification task is an imbalanced binary classification problem that we address using BERT BIBREF0. We use BERTBASE, uncased, which consists of 12 self-attention layers, and returns a 768-dimension vector that representation a sentence. So as to make use of BERT for sentence classification, we include a fully connected layer on top of the BERT self-attention layers, which classifies the sentence embedding provided by BERT into the two classes of interest (propaganda or non-propaganda).
